category_description: Federal income tax, payroll tax and other taxes in the United States.
subcategory_description: How gains from selling assets are taxed.
label: Most net capital loss you can deduct in a year
context: The lesser of this amount or your total net loss. The limit is half this amount if married filing separately. A larger loss carries forward to later years.

label: Loss limit, married filing separately
context: The most net capital loss a married person filing separately can deduct in a year.

label: Highest rate on collectibles gains
context: Net capital gains from selling collectibles such as coins or art are taxed at no more than this rate. Gain from qualified small business stock under section 1202 is taxed at a maximum of the same rate.

label: Highest rate on unrecaptured section 1250 gain
context: The portion of any unrecaptured section 1250 gain from selling real property is taxed at no more than this rate.

label: Net investment income tax rate
context: Charged on the lesser of net investment income or the excess of modified adjusted gross income over the threshold for your filing status.

label: Net investment income tax threshold, single or head of household
context: Modified adjusted gross income above this amount can bring the net investment income tax.

label: Net investment income tax threshold, married filing jointly
context: Also applies to a qualifying surviving spouse.

label: Net investment income tax threshold, married filing separately
context: Modified adjusted gross income above this amount can bring the net investment income tax.
